updates.protocol: Electron native autoUpdater / Squirrel.Mac JSON feed
updates.checks: automatic about once a day while the app is open (can be turned off in Settings), and on request; a found update downloads in the background and installs on restart

dependencyTreatment.productionDependencyGraph: npm packages whose modules the build compiled into app.asar (recorded by the build itself), merged with the npm lockfile graph for @intoponet/desktop; a lockfile dependency with no module in the app is marked excluded. Workspace TypeScript packages are compiled into app.asar by electron-vite.
dependencyTreatment.licenseReview: Package license metadata is inventory input only; no exhaustive license review is asserted.
